Metadata.title: TechToJob — A Tech Community for Talent and Companies
Metadata.description: Connect with tech talent, discover opportunities, build projects and prove your skills in a community built to grow together.

Hero.headline: Stop sending resumes into the void.
Hero.subheadline: TechToJob is the developer and company community where you're known for what you do, not just what's on your CV.

Testimonials.headline: Real conversations from the community
Testimonials.description: This is what TechToJob sounds like when people help, share and build together.

items.name: Alex Dev
items.quote: I came to ask a React question and ended up collaborating on a project with people from the server.

items.name: Lucía Code
items.quote: What I value most is being able to show what I'm building. Here nobody dismisses you for being junior.

items.name: Marcos Front
items.quote: In the #frontend channel someone solved my problem in 10 minutes. In other places I've been stuck for days.

items.name: Sara Ops
items.quote: I joined a tournament without expecting anything and ended up with a real project for my portfolio.

items.name: Dani Back
items.quote: Better than LinkedIn. Here you meet people before there's a job opening.

items.name: Nuria UX
items.quote: There's a channel where people share job openings that don't appear anywhere else.
